title: rosa sicula subvar. ligustica
intro: Rosa sicula subvar. ligustica, commonly known as the Ligurian rose, is a subvariety of the Rosa sicula plant, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of the Ligurian rose include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy for women's health issues. The bioactive constituents of the Ligurian rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
